title: get_external_usage input
description: How much of the repository calls code outside it: call sites per external module, type or member, with distinct files and projects and a few sample sites, for sizing a framework or library migration. Closed generic instantiations count together under their open definition unless fold_generics is false. Only calls that resolved to an external count; calls that did not bind name no target.

repository_id.description: Optional when exactly one repository is registered.

snapshot_id.description: Null pins the current published snapshot.

module.description: Only externals of this module: an assembly or package name, such as `EntityFramework`.

name_prefix.description: Only externals whose qualified name starts with this, such as a namespace or a type.

include_tests.description: Default true. False leaves out call sites in test code, recognised by path.

path_prefix.description: Only call sites in files under this path.

freshness.description: snapshot (default) answers from the published snapshot. strict first checks that the working tree is exactly what the snapshot was built from; if not, it starts an index and refuses with STALE_INPUT naming the changed files.

envelope.description: compact leaves out the snapshot-wide parts of the envelope (unresolved reasons, standing limitations) that an earlier answer from the same snapshot already gave; query-specific limits stay. Over MCP, answers after the first full one per snapshot are compact unless full is asked for.
